title: Deciphering KDM8 dysregulation and CpG methylation in hepatocellular carcinoma using multi-omics and machine learning.
summary: Multi-omics analysis with machine-learning selection identifies KDM8 dysregulation and CpG methylation patterns associated with hepatocellular carcinoma.
ai_technology: The study combines HCC expression/methylation datasets and reports candidate KDM8-related methylation and diagnostic/prognostic analyses.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Multi-omics analysis with machine-learning selection identifies KDM8 dysregulation and CpG methylation patterns associated with hepatocellular carcinoma.
evidence.unknown: The multi-omics associations do not establish that KDM8 dysregulation or methylation causes hepatocellular carcinoma or has clinical utility.
evidence.ai_role: The study combines HCC expression/methylation datasets and reports candidate KDM8-related methylation and diagnostic/prognostic analyses.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
